prompts.41:
Use case: productivity-visual. Illustration sheet for DP41 background in a serious Korean software architecture presentation. WHITE background, wide 3:1 canvas. Mature editorial pen and light watercolor, muted teal, charcoal, pale apricot, like a thoughtful professional office illustration. NOT a full slide.
Three separate subjects centered at 15%,50%,85% horizontal positions, each within its own third, pure white space BETWEEN subjects for native arrows. Do not draw connectors or labels. All subjects within middle 70% height with at least 15% white margin above and below.
LEFT: office user with glasses at desktop PC, speaking with hand on mouse. Screen has a selected spreadsheet table and TWO existing report document thumbnails, indicating context is needed to know which prior report; no labels. No physical pointing-camera interpretation.
CENTER: VIA desktop software window with a microphone and opposing dialogue bubbles, a small magnifying glass examining a selected table/document and a small question mark. Represents request understanding, not work execution. No robot or person.
RIGHT: a report document with a chart beside an email draft envelope and pen, accompanied by a subtle crossed-out paper-airplane symbol to indicate draft only, no sending. This represents the requested delegated work, not VIA doing the report.
No words, letters, IDs, digits, headings, badges, panel grid, clouds, logos or watermark. Only the question-mark/crossed-plane icons permitted. Clear, restrained professional silhouettes, not childish. No curves/arrows between subjects. Native slide captions will explain selected table, prior report, report-then-email dependency and no-send condition.
